name: MiniMax Group Inc.
summary: MiniMax Group Inc. engages in research and development of an artificial intelligence (AI) foundation model. The company's platform offers a wide range of modalities, including language, video, speech, and music. It also provides AI-based enterprise services; AI-native products, including enterprise-facing open platform; and consumer products, such as MiniMax Agent, Hailuo AI, Talkie and Xingye. The company was founded in 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
